root_cause: A fully-specified, committed acceptance test for a PURE FUNCTION leaves no empirical gap. The cold agent reads the test in its worktree and reverse-engineers the resolution strategy from the asserted behavior, regardless of how strategy-silent the prose spec is. The test IS the strategy reveal. This is the same structural reason v1-v7 lost; v4's prose hint was only the most blatant instance.
proposed_fix: To make a single-task memory-win authentically possible, the empirical fact must NOT be derivable from anything in the worktree. Options: (a) HIDDEN/held-out acceptance test the agent cannot read (test fixture withheld until grading, agent codes against prose-only spec) so the missing-session pattern is only knowable from the seeded note; (b) move from a pure-function spec to a task where the empirical fact is about the REAL runtime environment (e.g. an actual daemon data quirk only observable by running the live system), which a sandboxed worktree cannot reveal; (c) accept that the single-task premise is false for self-contained pure-function tasks and pivot the winning-case search to multi-task / cross-session settings where the expensive knowledge is genuinely external to any one task's artifacts.
